query: AMD stock price performance and analyst price targets

output.content:
**AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) — stock performance and Wall Street targets, as of the October 16, 2026 close.** [[1]]

- AMD closed at **$528.75** on October 16, 2026, versus **$214.16** at December 31, 2025, implying a **146.9% year-to-date gain**. [[1]] [[2]]
- Over the trailing 12 months, AMD rose from **$233.08 on October 17, 2025** to **$528.75 on October 16, 2026**, a reported **126.9% increase**. [[1]]
- The stock reached a closing high of **$649.42 on October 6, 2026** and was therefore **18.6% below that peak** at the October 16 close. [[1]]
- The same trailing-year period included a low of **$190.95 on March 3, 2026**, illustrating substantial volatility despite the strong overall return. [[1]]

**Analyst price-target snapshot**

| Measure | Value | Implied move vs. $528.75 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Consensus / average 12-month target | **$636.21** | **+20.3%** |
| Median target | **$635.50** | **+20.2%** |
| Lowest target | **$365** | **−31.0%** |
| Highest target | **$1,250** | **+136.4%** |

The S&P Global-based consensus covered **55 analysts** and rated AMD a **“Strong Buy.”** [[3]] 

The rating distribution reported by another source was **44 Buy, 11 Hold, and zero Sell**, which is constructive but also shows that the consensus target is not a unanimous forecast. [[4]] 

Recent bullish target revisions included **Citigroup to $800 from $575** on October 6, **Mizuho to $705 from $580** on October 6, **Stifel to $700 from $635** on October 5, and **BofA to $720 from $620** on September 25. [[4]]

**Takeaway:** AMD’s share-price performance has been exceptional—roughly **+147% YTD** through October 16—but the consensus target then indicated a more moderate **~20% additional upside**, while the unusually wide **$365–$1,250** target range signals very high disagreement over the durability and valuation of its AI/data-center growth outlook. [[1]] [[3]]
